51258975.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Ostrinia furnacalis chitinase h catalytic domain overexpressed in Pichia pastoris by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry. HsChit1, SmChIB, and OfChi-h were desalted into ITC buffer (50 mM NaH2PO4, 150 mM NaCl, pH 6.0). Compound 53 was dissolved in the same buffer. Measurements of HsChit1 were conducted at 25 °C with a stirring speed of 1000 rpm. After the baseline was balanced, 2.5 μL of 1 mM 53 was injected into a calorimeter cell containing 100 μM HsChit1. The injections were repeated 16 times over 180 s intervals. The background was measured by injecting the inhibitor into the cell containing only buffer. ITC experiments with SmChIB or OfChi-h were performed as described for HsChit1 but with different proteins and inhibitor concentrations (40 μM SmChIB, 400 μM 53 or 10 μM OfChi-h, 100 μM 53). After subtracting the blank, the integrated heat of injection was used to fit one site binding model using Microcal Origin 7.0. Gibbs free energy (ΔG) and the entropy change (ΔS) can be calculated from the enthalpy change (ΔH) and the binding constant K using ΔG = −RT ln K and ΔG = ΔH − TΔS.
original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Figure 6. Expression levels of Chit1 and cytokines in lung tissue from the no-treatment, the bleomycin-challenged, and the 40-treated bleomycin-challenged groups. The control contains 5% DMSO in PBS.
